exact-declaration-inventory.text: All forty-one declarations are stated with one intentional sorry each. The source-derived checker verifies exact identities and statement hashes. It does not inspect compiled axioms or establish proofs.

inversions-and-statement-domain.text: All inversions remain admitted. A general statement that terminal request custody can leave only through completion is missing. Escape refusal, reachable supply claims and finite terminal withdrawal cases do not replace that obligation.
